metaDescription: Learn how Penn KDSAP connects University of Pennsylvania students, physicians, and Philadelphia communities.
title: A student-led bridge between Penn and Philadelphia communities
summary: Penn KDSAP brings students, physicians, and community organizations together around kidney health screening, education, and service.
heroImageAlt: Penn KDSAP volunteers speaking with community members at a screening

sections.title: Local service within a nationwide movement
sections.text: Penn’s chapter was founded in 2017. Student volunteers from across the University work with physicians from Penn Medicine and community leaders throughout Philadelphia.

sections.title: Partnership comes before programming
sections.text: Community organizations help shape each collaboration. Penn KDSAP prepares volunteers, coordinates with clinicians, and brings screening and education activities into partner spaces.
